description: List fixed products that are currently public, active, available for sale, and orderable according to fresh DotMoose commerce data. When no fixed-family filter is supplied, the response also includes a curated directory for domains, Dedicated quotes, add-ons, licences, migrations, account features, and application-based programs. Those entries are guided handoffs rather than fixed products.
name: list_public_products
title: List current DotMoose products and other offerings
